outcome_sought: Raise a chargeback and refund the £1,349 paid for a sofa that was never delivered.
rationale: A chargeback for goods not received is a card scheme dispute, not a Parts 6-7 PSRs execution or authorisation issue, so the 8-week clock applies (CP-3.1) and it goes to Payments and Disputes, not Fraud and Scams. Her 'not happy' in chat on 10 Sep was arguably a complaint that should have been logged then (CP-1.1, CP-1.3), so the received date needs a team leader's view. The email she wants used is not the one on her record.
